armyRules.name: Strike and Withdraw
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. The Legion hits the line, breaks it and is gone before the counter-blow. A unit with this rule that wins a Combat may make a free Disengage move of up to 3" at the end of the Assault phase, but from the second consecutive turn it stays Locked in Combat it subtracts 1 from its Weapon Skill.
armyRules.condition: from the second consecutive turn Locked in Combat

armyRules.name: Horizon-Eaters
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. Swift riders are hard to pin down and badly suited to standing guard. A unit with this rule that moved 6" or more in its last Movement phase gains Shrouded (6+) against Shooting Attacks from more than 12" away, but it does not count as controlling an objective while it is Rushing.

armyRules.name: Honour of the Hunt
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. A White Scars Character leads from the front and is shamed by hanging back. A Character with this rule adds 1 to its Initiative on the turn it charges, but if it has neither charged nor been in a Challenge by the end of battle turn three, it subtracts 1 from its Cool Checks until it does.

wargear.name: Horsetail standard
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A tall pole hung with the manes of a hundred fallen rivals, which the unit follows as a banner and a challenge. Every model in the unit gains +1 Movement.

wargear.name: Stormcaller's totem
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A bone and feather fetish, empty of any power until a Stormseer decides otherwise. The model gains +1 Willpower and +1 Cool.

wargear.name: Thunder-drum
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A hide drum whose roll carries a mile and tells the enemy the riders are coming. Gives the unit Rolling Thunder.

wargear.name: Falcon-feather cloak
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A cloak of grey and white pinions that moves with the wind rather than against it. Gives the model Wind-Cloaked.

wargear.name: Oath-braid
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A braid of knotted horsehair, each knot a vow made to the Khan. Gives the model Sworn Knots.

wargear.name: Null-wind charm
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A strip of lacquered bone carved with a Stormseer's ward against the Warp. Gives the model Null-Wind Ward.

wargear.name: Dust-curtain dispensers
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Canisters of powdered ceramite scattered behind the vehicle as it runs. Gives the vehicle Dust Cloud.

wargear.name: Hunting horn
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A curved horn whose note calls the next wave of riders in from the flank. Gives the model Hunter's Call.

modifiers.text: Born to the saddle: +1 I, -1 LD.
Sworn to the Khan: +1 WS, -1 BS.
Voice of the storm: +1 IN, -1 CL.

rules.name: Storm Riders
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Great Hunt). Riders who burst out of the flank are already committed. A unit with this rule that enters play from Reserves may declare a Charge on the turn it arrives.

rules.name: Khagan's Escort
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Khagan's Own). The Khan's chosen ride where he rides. While within 12" of the Khan, Qin Xa or Hibou Khan, a unit with this rule adds +1 to its Cool Checks and to its Charge rolls.

rules.name: Tempest-Born
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Calling the Tempest). Wind, dust and lightning gather round the Stormseers' brothers. A unit with this rule gains Shrouded (6+) against Shooting Attacks.

rules.name: Killers in the Dark
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Dark Sons Descend). The Dark Sons are in place before the enemy knows a fight has begun. A unit with this rule gains Infiltrate (9). On the first battle turn, enemy units may not make Reaction Shooting against it.

rules.name: Rolling Thunder
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Enemy Reaction Shooting against the unit subtracts 1 from its Hit Tests on the turn the unit charges.

rules.name: Wind-Cloaked
rules.text: Legacy house rule. The bearer gains Shrouded (6+) against Shooting Attacks from more than 12" away.

rules.name: Sworn Knots
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Once per battle, the bearer's unit automatically passes one Cool Check.

rules.name: Null-Wind Ward
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Enemy Psychic Checks that target the bearer's unit subtract 1 from the result.

rules.name: Dust Cloud
rules.text: Legacy house rule. After the vehicle Rushes, enemy Shooting Attacks against it subtract 1 from their Hit Tests until the start of its next turn.

rules.name: Hunter's Call
rules.text: Legacy house rule. A friendly unit that arrives from Reserves within 12" of the bearer adds 1 to its Charge roll on that turn.

rites.name: The Great Hunt
rites.flavor: The steppe has no fortresses. It has only prey that has not yet noticed it is being run down.
benefits: Outrider Squadrons, Scimitar Jetbike Squadrons and Golden Keshig may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Those units gain Storm Riders: Outflank, and a unit entering from Reserves may still Charge that turn.
limitations: At least two Outrider, Scimitar or Keshig units are required.
At least one unit with Storm Riders must start the battle in Reserves.
No Terminator squads, and no Armour, Heavy Transport or War Engine units.

modifiers.text: The Great Hunt: Line (1), Storm Riders, Outflank.

require.note: Bring at least two cavalry squads.

rites.name: The Khagan's Own
rites.flavor: When the Khan's own riders and shadows take the line, the rest of the Legion simply follows.
benefits: Golden Keshig and Ebon Keshig may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Keshig gain Khagan's Escort: while within 12" of the Khan, Qin Xa or Hibou Khan they add +1 to Cool Checks and to Charge rolls.
limitations: The Khan, Qin Xa or Hibou Khan must lead the army.
At least two Keshig units are required.
No Tactical, Despoiler, Breacher, Scout or Inductii Squads.

modifiers.text: The Khagan's Own: Line (1), Khagan's Escort.

require.note: The Khan, Qin Xa or Hibou Khan must lead the army.
Bring at least two Keshig units.

rites.name: Calling the Tempest
rites.flavor: The Stormseers raise their voices, and the sky answers in kind.
benefits: Falcon's Claws may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Stormseers and Falcon's Claws gain Tempest-Born: Shrouded (6+) against Shooting Attacks.
limitations: At least two Stormseers are required.
No Armour, Heavy Transport or Lord of War units.

rites.name: Dark Sons Descend
rites.flavor: No one remembers the Dark Sons' names. They like it that way, and so does the Khan.
benefits: Dark Sons of Death may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Dark Sons gain Killers in the Dark: Infiltrate (9), and enemy units may not make Reaction Shooting against them on the first battle turn.
limitations: At least two Dark Sons of Death squads are required.
No Stormseers or other models with the Psyker Trait.

modifiers.text: Dark Sons Descend: Line (1), Killers in the Dark, Infiltrate (9).

require.note: Bring at least two Dark Sons of Death squads.
